source.selected_windows: Four consecutive first-of-month 4-hour UTC windows. The first study fixed Jan and Apr; Feb and Mar complete the consecutive-month series.

method.scope: Exact Binance USD-M ETHUSDT settings from the archive and checksum-bound public parameter form. Cold simulation uses the native 10,000 USDT default, 10x leverage and the four saved source overrides. Four consecutive first-of-month four-hour UTC windows inside the author horizon. January and April were preselected initially. February and March fill the calendar gap and all four outcomes remain present. February supplies two closed outcomes. All windows leave modeled inventory and outstanding orders at cutoff.
method.ema: Give the original code native FMZ TA.EMA on 4,999 confirmed hourly bars and the evolving current bar. Independent Decimal arithmetic verifies each selected previous completed-hour EMA. The 3% lock guard did not trigger. The source recalculates on each outer loop. A separate native fixture verifies the exact two-decimal placement prices, including near-half-cent values from weighted entry.
method.fill: Use known recorded signed trade prints strictly through each resting price and after posting, supported by another Binance checksummed archive keyed by raw fills. The primary threshold is the full order size and the sensitivity requires double. No maker queue or historical account identity is inferred. Use the contemporaneous book for marketability and verified historical 20 USDT opening minimum.
method.accounting: Track the captured funding settlement and marks with exact independent Decimal arithmetic. Maker fees are 0.02%; taker fees are 0.04%, and these scoped paths did not use taker. All fees, closed and open funding allocations, valuations, margin buffer and marked drawdown are listed separately.
